text:
alex_support: @maria_sales looping you—ACME Media (acct acme-234) requested 10x token rate increase for next 30 days to support video-transcription burst. Ticket #98721.

maria_sales: Asking because they're close to launch and need 200k tokens/day for first week. Request came from CSM -> customer success.

alex_support: Ran automated checks. quota-bot: "policy_check: suspicious_activity=false; recent_chargebacks=0; avg_qps=3". But noticed sudden unknown IPs hitting API 2 days ago.

lee_fraud: Can you paste the IPs & sample logs? I'll run device/fingerprint check.

alex_support: Logs:
```
[2025-05-08T14:02:31Z] req=/v1/generate uid=acct:acme-234 ip=34.212.120.9 tokens=1200
[2025-05-08T14:02:33Z] req=/v1/generate uid=acct:acme-234 ip=52.34.44.231 tokens=4500
```

lee_fraud: 34.212.120.9 is known cloud-proxy range; 52.34.44.231 flagged in past for rapid rotate. I need 1 hour to correlate with fraud DB. Recommend holding full auto-uplift.

jordan_pm: If fraud blocks uplift, ops/product can offer limited-per-route burst: max tokens per request 5000, daily cap 250k, and strict keys rotation. Is that acceptable to sales/CS?

maria_sales: Customer insists on 10x. They're willing to sign short-term addendum with stricter SLAs. Can we do a provisional uplift with monitoring and rapid rollback?

lee_fraud: We can approve provisional if three conditions met: 1) IP allowlist for identified IPs, 2) enable enhanced rate logging (X-Client-Req-Id), 3) 6-hour manual review checkpoint. Otherwise deny.

alex_support: I'll add those as requirements on the ticket and start the allowlist/monitoring. Escalating to product for temporary exception approval. tagging @jordan_pm in the ticket.

quota-bot: "exception_request 98721 status=escalated reviewers=jordan_pm,lee_fraud"

jordan_pm: I'll review and sign off if fraud check clears. Please add customer contract note and expected rollback time. Thanks :thumbsup:
